title: One affine weakly contractible cover of a quasi-compact pro-etale object
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with universes [def-weil-size-convention]. For every object $T\to X$ whose scheme $T$ is quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], there exists a covering family consisting of one morphism $V\to T$, where $V$ is affine and weakly contractible in the full site $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Here weakly contractible means that for every epimorphism $F\to G$ of sheaves of sets on this site, $F(V)\to G(V)$ is surjective.
